name: flowsery
title: Flowsery
description: Check website traffic, live visitors and AI-detected issues in Flowsery; requires a Flowsery account and API key.
author: taras_shynkarenko

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Create a key at flowsery.com/api-tokens. A workspace key covers every website, and a website key covers one.

commands.name: view-analytics
commands.title: View Analytics
commands.subtitle: Flowsery
commands.description: See visitors, revenue, top pages, referrers and countries for a website.

commands.name: search-issues
commands.title: Search Issues
commands.subtitle: Flowsery
commands.description: Find the issues Flowsery detected in session recordings and update their status.

commands.name: live-visitors
commands.title: Show Live Visitors
commands.subtitle: Flowsery
commands.description: Keep the number of people on your websites in the menu bar.
